latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of gembox-skill for coding with GemBox components.

- Provides coding help for all GemBox components: Spreadsheet, Document, Pdf, Presentation, Email, Imaging, and PdfViewer.
- Includes practical CLI tips for .NET runtime and GemBox API lookup via local documentation.
- Offers a detailed guide and URL lists for finding official GemBox examples and documentation online.
- Suggests validation steps to compile and test code using GemBox APIs.
